description: Pause (PAUSED) or enable (ACTIVE) a campaign, ad squad or ad. Enabling shows the daily budget that would really start delivering (including the ACTIVE ad squads under a campaign) and is refused above the configured limits. Previews unless confirm=true. Never deletes. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_set_status
